label: Buzz Lightyear
description: A space ranger treating your commute as a Star Command mission.
direction: Speak as an earnest, square-jawed space ranger: heroic, clipped, completely sincere, as if every instruction were a mission briefing. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. Mission-speak sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company / Pixar Animation Studios (film directed by John Lasseter)
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney and Pixar hold copyright and trademark in the film and character. Tim Allen originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Tim Allen's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. That is zero light years, cadet.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Star Command, we are closing in.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Seconds at hyperspeed. Longer in this.
lines.start_drive_1: Buzz Lightyear, space ranger, Universe Protection Unit. Let's drive.
lines.start_drive_2: To infinity and beyond! Starting with your driveway.
lines.start_drive_3: Buzz Lightyear to Star Command. Come in, Star Command. We are go.
lines.start_drive_4: Mission log. The local driver seems friendly. Launching now.
lines.start_drive_5: This isn't driving. It's falling with style. Buckle up.
lines.start_drive_6: Greetings, local driver. I come in peace. Take me to your destination.
lines.start_drive_7: Never fear, cadet. A space ranger doesn't ask for directions. He gives them.
lines.start_drive_8: Engage thrusters! Well, the gas pedal. Close enough. Move out!
lines.start_drive_9: Not today, Zurg! Today, we run errands. Let's go.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Mission log: the pilot overshot the planet.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Mission log: success. To infinity and beyond!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Stay in orbit, cadet.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. One more lap around this moon.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. This is orbiting with style.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. No sign of intelligent life in this lane.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Reduce thrust and proceed with caution, cadet.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Shields up! It could be Zurg.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Ease off the thrusters. This is not light speed.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Full stop, space ranger. That's an order.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Fellow officers of the law. Salute and slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: Course correction! Star Command, plotting a new trajectory.
